text:
eli: heads-up — started Ember13B onboarding (converted from upstream weights). initial int4 quant runs show a weird drop in summarization ROUGE-L (~6 pts) only on long-context evals. logs attached below.

jamal: can you paste the conversion command?

eli: sure — ran: 
```
python convert.py --model ember13b.ckpt --out ember13b.safetensors --format hf --rotary=hybrid --headmap=llama->mistral
python quantize.py --input ember13b.safetensors --bits 4 --group-size 128 --out ember13b.int4.safetensors
```

sophia: hybrid rotary + llama->mistral headmap — hmmm. did you run a tokenmap sanity? sometimes the tokenizer byte offsets shift and kvcache lookup reads wrong ids.

eli: ran basic sanity (lm scoring short prompts) — unimodal. regression only when sequence > 2048 and when we enable `use_kv_sharding=true` in runtime.

marie: any diff in embedding matrix or BOS/EOS indices after conversion? those often bite us.

eli: embedding checksum matches upstream, but discovered a sentinel index mismatch: upstream used 214 as sentinel, our tokenizer conversion set 0 for `pad_token_id` and left sentinel as 214 — probably fine but suspicious.

jamal: can we reproduce in fp16? if fp16 baseline is fine, it narrows to quant+runtime.

eli: fp16 baseline (same converted safetensors, no quant) passes long-context evals within ~0.5 pts of upstream. so quant+runtime suspect.

bench-bot: Ember13B | eval/summarize_longctx | fp16: ROUGE-L 42.1 | int4_runtimeA: ROUGE-L 36.0 | int4_runtimeB: ROUGE-L 41.8

sophia: interesting — runtimeA vs runtimeB diff. what are the runtimes?

eli: runtimeA is our new continuous-batching runtime (kv-sharding enabled), runtimeB is older single-gpu fallback (no kv-sharding).

marie: that points to kvcache token alignment or rotary indexing differing between sharded and non-sharded paths. possibly a headwise offset on rotary sin/cos tables when tensors are split.

jamal: can you dump the per-layer rotary angle checksums before and after sharding? e.g., compare cos_table[:8] hash across paths.

eli: doing that now. small snippet I ran: 
```
# in runtimeA after load
for i, layer in enumerate(model.layers[:3]):
    print(i, layer.rotary_cos[:8].mean().item())
```

eli: output (runtimeA): 
layer0 0.8721
layer1 0.8675
layer2 0.8612

eli: output (runtimeB): 
layer0 0.8721
layer1 0.8675
layer2 0.8612

eli: so tables look identical on load.

sophia: then maybe the issue is token id offsets when slicing sequence chunks for sharded kvcache; if a pad/sentinel is appended differently per shard, rotary phase applied to the wrong positions.

jamal: any evidence of off-by-one in the kvcache index? check per-step `kv_index` values emitted during generation.

eli: I instrumented generation. For a failing trace (runtimeA) I see repeated sequence where `kv_index` jumps by group_size occasionally: 0,1,2,...,127,256,257,... instead of 128. looks like a missing +128 chunk in one shard.

marie: aha. that would map tokens into wrong rotary positions for those heads — explains drop only on long contexts when chunking occurs.

sophia: is this happening only with int4 enabled?

eli: yes — same generation with fp16 on runtimeA doesn't show the kv_index jump. suggests quant path's packing logic interacts poorly with sharded pointer arithmetic.

jamal: likely an integer division/floor bug in the packer that uses `//` vs `/` and then cast to int causing group boundaries to skip when sizes align oddly.

sophia: propose quick mitigations: 1) disable kv_sharding for Ember13B int4 until fix; 2) add assertion in packer to ensure monotonic kv_index; 3) add unit test for group-edge cases.

eli: I can hotfix runtime config to disable kv_sharding for Ember13B int4. will also open a PR with failing unit test + bisect.

jamal: please include a small reproducer script and the failing token index trace in the PR. also label as P1 for Dedicated/Private customers using ember13b.

bench-bot: PR created: #4821 — reproducer + failing trace attached.

marie: long-term we should add a regression eval in Optimize pipeline: run long-context summarization for any newly onboarded model with sharded-int quant config before marking as ready.

sophia: agreed — I'll add a matrix entry: {quant: [fp16, int4], runtime: [sharded, nonsharded], seq_len: [512,2048,8192]}. run on CI smoke lane.

eli: hotfixing now. will push new int4 artifact with kv_sharding disabled and re-run nightly evals.

jamal: thanks. ping me when the hotfix artifact is uploaded.

eli: uploaded ember13b.int4.noshard.safetensors to gcs://redwood-models/ember13b/176888/ — rerunning.

bench-bot: Ember13B | eval/summarize_longctx | int4_noshard: ROUGE-L 41.6 (regression reduced)

marie: nice. not perfect but acceptable as temporary measure. we'll track performance vs cost tradeoff.

sophia: I'll start a PR to fix packer arithmetic and add unit tests.

eli: thanks all — leaving the thread here with links in the PR for follow-up. :thumbsup:
